description: A four-input adder and a one-into-four mult in 2HP, with the mult reading the adder's output when its own input is left empty

params.text: Switches the merge section between adding its inputs and averaging them; green is averaging

inputs.text: One of the four signals the merge section adds; unpatched jacks are left out
The signal the mult section copies; with the jack empty it reads the merge output above

outputs.text: Carries the four merge inputs added together, or their average when the button is green
A copy of the mult section's input, with the same number of channels

notes: leaving the mult input empty turns the module into a merge with four copies of the result, which the arrowheads on the panel show
menu: Negative-mode: Negative (default), Zero, Absolute (input), Absolute (output) — chooses what happens to negative voltages before or after the sum
Quantize mode — rounds the output to the nearest step of the size chosen, from a twelfth of a volt up to 5V, and is Off unless you set it
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed

inputs.4:
polyphonic

unpatched it reads the merge output.
